_note: Questions for the snapshot RAG eval (openspec snapshot-rag D11). Written by Claude on 2026-10-30 from the local snapshot chunks, not from retrieval output: each answerable question's `gold` is a page and a sentence found by a regular-expression search over the chunk text (tuition amounts, counts of letters or referees, interview statements), then phrased as an applicant would ask it. Unanswerable ones name a school with no stored page, or one none of whose stored pages mentions the topic (checked by a regular expression over every chunk of the school). AI-labelled; to be reviewed by MortyYJT. `python -m evals.run_passages --check` confirms every gold quote is in a stored chunk of its page.
